# Cncf Featurehub Reviewer

Review FeatureHub using its official documentation and repository in the Observability and Analysis / Feature Flagging category. FeatureHub is a Cloud Native Feature Flags, Remote Configuration and A/B Testing Platform suitable for mobile, web and server applications and available with the variety of SDKs. Self-hosted open source or SaaS options are available.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
